task_specification.objective: Deliver three bounded, closure-ready repairs covering the selected active issues and all required release-convergence gaps while preserving the authored cemetery, upgrade silhouettes, ordinary wave semantics, and dense-profile contract.

diagnosis.root_cause: Three unresolved integration families remain: authored-world binding and ordinary-route qualification, upgrade-draft focus/layout visibility, and deterministic dense-profile evidence readiness. Prior treatments did not close the perimeter void, ordinary five-wave route, CardB sibling clipping, or MCP timeout.

stop_conditions: Do not add unrelated capability work during convergence mode.
Stop candidate work at the three repair families; Runtime and Tester own recapture, verdicts, and issue closure.
Do not replace preserved authored environment or upgrade assets without package-level incompatibility evidence.

strategy.rationale: Apply distinct root-cause strategies: restore authored-world binding plus outer datum/collision for spatial integrity, repair the upgrade presentation container and focus navigation for card visibility and visual hierarchy, and isolate dense lifecycle/reporting instrumentation so host MCP rebind and recapture are deterministic.

code: Run focused candidate checks for cemetery binding/collision, wave eligibility and boss guards, upgrade choice hierarchy/layout/focus constraints, and dense lifecycle receipts.
Verify no parser/resource errors and preserve native_godot_project and host_godot_boot baselines.
runtime: GameLoop Runtime rebinds or restarts Godot MCP as needed, then recaptures the spatial route, upgrade interaction, and dense profile with the prescribed bounded probes.

Tester performs same-loop black-box and white-box retests for every assigned issue: four perimeter approaches and ordinary five-wave progression, all-card focus/confirm flow, and dense prepare/advance/reset receipts.
visual: Capture cemetery spawn, critical route, central-building/landmark, and perimeter viewpoints; confirm coherent external depth, no black void, no disappearance/occlusion drift, and no collision pass-through.

Capture the upgrade draft at native resolution in CardA, CardB, CardC, CardB focus, and confirmation states; confirm visual hierarchy, silhouettes or icons, truthful current-to-new values, no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, and all three fixed cards remain visible.
Capture the dense-profile gameplay/state view at 1920x1080 with required composition, no occlusion or error overlays, and no orphan-node artifacts.

done_when: Expand to a larger traversable scale with a coherent external world or external depth beyond the cemetery perimeter.
The central building or landmark remains visible during ordinary movement or movement replay with no disappearance or camera-occlusion drift.
Authored streets, the central landmark, spawn/objective anchors, and the boundary or perimeter have aligned collision; traversal shows no pass-through or visible black void.
The ordinary five-wave route progresses from a normal run start through its authored wave ids and escalating compositions, requests the Bellkeeper exactly once, and excludes diagnostic jumps.
Tester can directly retest the repaired route with black-box ordinary movement plus white-box spatial and wave-state probes.
tasks.instructions: Repair world integration at the binding layer rather than adding decorative proxy geometry. Inspect the complete authored cemetery instance, expand the traversable space where its bounds are undersized, rebase spawn/objective/collision/navigation onto native streets, and add only a coherent outer datum and gameplay boundary as needed. Correct camera/framing so the central building/landmark and perimeter remain stable during ordinary movement. Restore ordinary wave-director eligibility and exactly-once boss guards so a normal five-wave route can reach Bellkeeper defeat, Result, and Retry; do not use diagnostic acceleration as qualification. Preserve the authored cemetery package and minimize unrelated proxy/support clutter.
tasks.title: Restore authored cemetery scale, boundary, collision, and ordinary route

done_when: All three authored upgrade cards remain simultaneously visible in fixed 328x522 slots at native shipped resolution.
The visual hierarchy leads with authored silhouettes or icons, then compact stat icons and aligned current-to-new values.
Each card shows no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas; CURRENT values are truthful existing values with no NEW or LOCKED placeholder, and unchanged or exhaustive rows are omitted.
Keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states identify the focused card without clipping, hiding, or displacing sibling choices.
The draft remains paused until confirmation, applies exactly once before resume, and shows the selected confirmation beat.
